# nobus Provider

Manage infrastructure on [Nobus Cloud](https://cloud.nobus.io) through the public Nobus API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    nobus = {
      source = "nobus-cloud/nobus"
    }
  }
}

provider "nobus" {
  # Preferred: read the API key from a sensitive variable.
  api_key = var.nobus_api_key

  # Optional. Defaults shown below; each can also be supplied through the
  # matching NOBUS_* environment variable.
  # endpoint         = "https://cloud-api.nobus.io"
  # project_id       = var.nobus_project_id
  # availability_zone = "nobus-wa-az1"
}

variable "nobus_api_key" {
  description = "Nobus API key, sent as a bearer token."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "nobus_project_id" {
  description = "Nobus project that owns the resources."
  type        = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Nobus API key, sent as a bearer token. Can also be set with the `NOBUS_API_KEY` environment variable. Keep the key in a sensitive variable rather than in version control.
- `availability_zone` (String) Default availability zone applied to resources that do not set their own `availability_zone`. Defaults to `nobus-wa-az1`, the value the Nobus API itself defaults to. Can also be set with the `NOBUS_AVAILABILITY_ZONE` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Nobus API. Defaults to `https://cloud-api.nobus.io`. Can also be set with the `NOBUS_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `project_id` (String) Default Nobus project ID applied to resources that do not set their own `project_id`. Can also be set with the `NOBUS_PROJECT_ID` environment variable.
